title: クレーンゲーム大成功！

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Heehee… Heeheeheehee… This would be completely unforgivable in reality, but…

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: I've got my very own Uma harem!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: I can recreate dreamy situations and ship together pairs I've never seen in real life… The possibilities are endless!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Thank you so much, Trainer! You're the best partner a simp could ask for!
